title: REC: Craft
description: A mod made by content creators for content creators!
body:
REC: Craft is a mod made by content creators for content creators.

This project is currently experimental and is subject to change as development continues. Any version uploaded before the official release has a possibility of not working properly, so please be aware before downloading and using it.

REC: Craft is basically an integrated recording feature for Minecraft! It gives users HUGE amounts of freedom to control exactly what they capture in a recording. As a content creator, we often have to sacrafice all these cool mods that enhance our experience while playing the game simply because it will clutter up the screen and look bad in a video. That's what REC: Craft is here to solve. Users will be able to disable any overlays, or control the volume of different sounds output by other mods! This will allow us content creators to enjoy these quality of life mods without worrying about these extra sounds or overlays getting caught by the recording software!

If a mod or resource pack is not showing up as an option to hide, you might need to send a request for it to be supported. This is because, to ensure people can not use the mod to hide things like hack clients or xray, only the essentials will be compatible with the mod at first.
